sections.content: How many people are "vehicle body builders and repairers"?

21,320 people

were counted on the census as "vehicle body builders and repairers" in England and Wales in March 2021.
Vehicle body builders and repairers construct and repair the bodies of road vehicles, and fit interior and exterior fittings to vehicle bodies.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "vehicle body builders and repairers" there were more men than women (97.9% compared with 2.1%).

This means "vehicle body builders and repairers" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades".

Men made up 97.9% and women made up 2.1% of "vehicle body builders and repairers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "vehicle body builders and repairers" included:

  • welding trades
  • stonemasons and related trades
  • road construction operatives

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "vehicle body builders and repairers" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 50 to 54 years. Of the whole working population 11.7% were aged 50 to 54 years. For people working as "vehicle body builders and repairers", 13% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "vehicle body builders and repairers" was 16 to 19 years.

We can look at who worked as "vehicle body builders and repairers" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

There is a higher number of men than women with this occupation across all age groups. The age profile for men and women is shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "vehicle body builders and repairers" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "vehicle body builders and repairers", 8.5% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (86.8% compared with 13.2%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (72.1%) than self-employed (27.9%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was Yorkshire and the Humber. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Kingston upon Hull, City of, this is in the same region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
